# gitmoap_repository_fork_settings (Data Source)

Get a repository's fork settings. Who may fork this repository and where to, who may propose changes to it from a fork, and how its pipelines treat those proposals — each as it applies here, with where the value came from: the repository itself, a group above it, or the default. A value a group above enforces says so. Anyone who can see the repository may read them.

The token needs `repo:read`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repo_id` (String) Repository ID

### Read-Only

- `allow_maintainer_edits` (Attributes) One effective fork setting: its value, where it came from — `default`, `repository`, or `group:<id>` — and whether a group above enforces it as a ceiling. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--allow_maintainer_edits))
- `closed_proposal_retention_days` (Attributes) One effective fork setting: its value, where it came from — `default`, `repository`, or `group:<id>` — and whether a group above enforces it as a ceiling. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--closed_proposal_retention_days))
- `fork_merge_requests` (Attributes) One effective fork setting: its value, where it came from — `default`, `repository`, or `group:<id>` — and whether a group above enforces it as a ceiling. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fork_merge_requests))
- `forking` (Attributes) One effective fork setting: its value, where it came from — `default`, `repository`, or `group:<id>` — and whether a group above enforces it as a ceiling. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--forking))
- `min_account_age_days` (Attributes) One effective fork setting: its value, where it came from — `default`, `repository`, or `group:<id>` — and whether a group above enforces it as a ceiling. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--min_account_age_days))
- `outbound_merge_requests` (Attributes) One effective fork setting: its value, where it came from — `default`, `repository`, or `group:<id>` — and whether a group above enforces it as a ceiling. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--outbound_merge_requests))
- `override_group_settings` (Boolean) For a repository: whether its own row counts. A repository's settings apply only while this
is on.
- `proposal_runs` (Attributes) One effective fork setting: its value, where it came from — `default`, `repository`, or `group:<id>` — and whether a group above enforces it as a ceiling. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proposal_runs))

<a id="nestedatt--allow_maintainer_edits"></a>
### Nested Schema for `allow_maintainer_edits`

Read-Only:

- `enforced` (Boolean) Whether a group above enforces this field: a scope beneath may tighten it and never loosen
it. Absent for a field that cannot be enforced.
- `source` (String) Where the value comes from: `default`, `repository`, or `group:<id>`.
- `value` (Boolean) Whether the author of a merge request from a fork may let the people who can merge it push to its source branch.

<a id="nestedatt--fork_merge_requests"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fork_merge_requests`

Read-Only:

- `enforced` (Boolean) Whether a group above enforces this field: a scope beneath may tighten it and never loosen
it. Absent for a field that cannot be enforced.
- `source` (String) Where the value comes from: `default`, `repository`, or `group:<id>`.
- `value` (String) `disabled`: nobody. `members`: only people who hold a grant on the repository. `everyone`: anyone who can read it.


<a id="nestedatt--forking"></a>
### Nested Schema for `forking`

Read-Only:

- `enforced` (Boolean) Whether a group above enforces this field: a scope beneath may tighten it and never loosen
it. Absent for a field that cannot be enforced.
- `source` (String) Where the value comes from: `default`, `repository`, or `group:<id>`.
- `value` (String) `disabled`: never. `organization`: only into, or towards, the repository's own organization. `anywhere`: any group the person may create repositories in, or any repository of the network. A private repository's `anywhere` is `organization`: private code never forks out of its organization.

- `source` (String) Where the value comes from: `default`, `repository`, or `group:<id>`.
- `value` (Number) Accounts younger than this many days may not open a cross-repository merge request: 0 to 30.

- `source` (String) Where the value comes from: `default`, `repository`, or `group:<id>`.
- `value` (String) `disabled`: never. `organization`: only into, or towards, the repository's own organization. `anywhere`: any group the person may create repositories in, or any repository of the network. A private repository's `anywhere` is `organization`: private code never forks out of its organization.


<a id="nestedatt--proposal_runs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `proposal_runs`

Read-Only:

- `enforced` (Boolean) Whether a group above enforces this field: a scope beneath may tighten it and never loosen
it. Absent for a field that cannot be enforced.
- `source` (String) Where the value comes from: `default`, `repository`, or `group:<id>`.
- `value` (String) `approve_each_head`: run nothing until a Developer approves that exact commit. `run_untrusted`: run every such head at once, without secrets — spending the repository's minutes on every contribution.
